item.title: Felon Admits Killing Man in Moreno Valley
item.description: A felon who gunned down a 30-year-old man during a confrontation in Moreno Valley, then fled to another city where he was apprehended, pleaded guilty Monday to second-degree murder. item.title: Man Convicted in Abduction, Rape in Huntington Beach
item.description: A 52-year-old man was convicted Monday for his role in the abduction and sexual assault of a woman from a Huntington Beach street.
